remarks: Discover urban convenience and modern living at Arch Hill Commons with this stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit on the 1st floor. Located in the heart of Norwalk, CT, this home offers a prime location with easy access to shopping, dining, parks, the highway and public transportation, great for commuters. Inside, you'll find an inviting space with lots of natural sunlight that features contemporary finishes and hardwood flooring throughout. The kitchen boasts granite countertops, a tiled backsplash and floor. The spacious bedroom displays decorative moulding which provides a comfortable retreat after a busy day. The bathroom is fully renovated with marble floors and a whirlpool tub. Freshly painted and extra insulation in the ceiling. Over-sized laundry and extra storage in the basement. Plenty of parking in the front of the building with 2 unassigned spaces in the back. Don't miss out on the chance to call this charming Norwalk address home!
